title: After the 2026-11-12 19:16Z restart: relay boundaries 2010/2011 for session-14548 failed 'session not found', three proxy tails inconsistent, four check credits Unknown
outcome: Each anomaly in Greg's 19:16Z startup log is explained from evidence, and none of them loses a message or a credit. Sequence 2 of the native relay messages for session-14548 is either delivered or still durable and retried, and a lasting defect gets a fix. The inconsistent proxy tails and the Unknown check credits have a stated cause, and any real defect is fixed or filed. The original instance is never just repeated.
acceptance: Delivery of the native relay boundary messages 2010/2011 for session-14548 (mailbox-2459dccf-2ce9-4d59-8341-08450acdf458 and mailbox-d00d58a8-b076-4136-a864-6d33b0f21160, sequence 2) is established from the mailbox and relay state: delivered, still durable and pending, or lost. If they are not delivered after the inventory completed, the cause of 'session not found' is established, and a fix lands with a test that first fails on the unmodified host.

The proxy tail inconsistencies (session-16529 64/63, session-16551 64/62, session-16702 64/63) are explained from the code and state: harmless start-up lag, or a defect. A defect gets a fix with a behavioural test, or its own item.

The four Unknown check credits in session-13196 are explained from the run records before any check is repeated: still pending settlement, lost by the restart, or something else. If a restart loses a credit, that defect is fixed or filed as its own item.
